Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 14
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical reasoning error in Step 14 by incorrectly concluding that the parent company of Apple Records is Universal Music Group (UMG) based on the visible text on the Britannica page. The visible text only mentioned that Apple Records was a label used by James Taylor and that the Beatles launched the label; it did not state UMG is the parent. The Planner confused the current *distributor* (which may be UMG) with the historical *parent company* (Apple Corps Ltd). This error led the team down the wrong path, ignoring the clear evidence from other search results (Wikipedia, Everything Explained Today) that explicitly identified Apple Corps Ltd as the parent company.
